content.text:
Fixed! The issue was floating-point precision. When converting decimal amounts to cents (multiplying by 100), JavaScript was producing values like `3995.0000000000005` instead of exactly `3995`, which failed the integer validation.

I added `Math.round()` to three conversion functions to handle this:
- `parseEuros()` in money.js
- `cellCents()` in money.js  
- `decimalCommaToCents()` in locale.js

Now your Gym subscription at 39.95 (and any other price) should work fine.
